name: Gradient Blinds
description: WebGL2 background of vertical gradient slats like window blinds, lit by a soft spotlight that follows the pointer, with sway, click ripples, grain and an intro settle.
contents: Full-size container with a single WebGL2 canvas rendering the gradient blinds shader
behavior: Gradient is split into blind slats, each tilting with a slow sway animation
Spotlight follows the pointer with spring damping, and drifts on its own when the pointer is outside
Clicks inside spawn ripple waves across the slats (up to 4 at once)
Intro animation settles the blinds on mount
Animated film grain over the surface
Rendering pauses when offscreen, tab hidden, or paused prop is true
Reduced-motion users get no intro, sway, drift, gradient animation, or ripples
editableByProps: Gradient colors (up to 8 stops), mirroring, animated gradient shift, angle, perspective and distortion
Blind count and minimum width, shine, relief, glow, sway, hover tilt and speed
Spotlight radius, softness, opacity, color, follow damping and idle behavior (drift or center)
Grain amount, intro on or off, click ripple on or off, paused state
Dark or light (white paper) rendering via lightMode, CSS blend mode, className and style

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the default fallback gradient colors
needsCodeEdit.where: Default arrays in prepStops and colorKey

needsCodeEdit.change: Change ripple duration or number of simultaneous ripples
Change shading, slat tilt or light-mode look

fixed: Requires WebGL2; renders nothing if unavailable or the shader fails to compile
Fills its parent (h-full w-full), so the parent needs a defined size and relative placement behind content
Listens to pointer events on window, so the spotlight and ripples react anywhere on the page, not only over the element
Maximum 8 gradient colors and 4 simultaneous ripples
Canvas is aria-hidden and purely decorative
Mix blend mode is ignored in lightMode
Blind count is capped by container width divided by blindMinWidth, so narrow screens show fewer slats
